summary: Master mobile app development for iOS and Android with our expert-led course. Equip yourself with the skills needed to thrive in the tech industry.
lede: Android app development covers planning, building, testing, and preparing mobile applications for release. For foundation-level learners and early-career practitioners, this course uses Flutter and Dart to create interfaces, manage state, connect REST APIs, handle local data and authentication, and test user journeys. It also introduces SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose as platform-specific reference points while covering security checks and release planning for iOS and Android.
audienceIntro: This mobile app development course is designed for professionals who need to create, test, manage, or support applications across iOS and Android. It suits foundation-level learners with basic digital literacy and early-career practitioners who want a structured route into cross-platform application delivery. The course is particularly relevant to anyone who must contribute to a mobile product backlog, prototype a user journey, review technical work, or coordinate a release.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with permission to install Flutter, Dart, Git, and a suitable code editor such as Visual Studio Code or Android Studio. The course supplies a guided project brief, sample JSON data, API exercises, and mobile test scenarios. You do not need paid software, an existing app, or an Apple or Google developer account for the classroom prototype, although store submission requires separate platform accounts and review processes.
